changes: Six Classic footer symbols have original paired theme SVGs: pointer, selection, canvas dimensions, fit, zoom in/out. The dimensions symbol is distinct from a picture-file icon; zoom glyphs retain blue accents. Metric glyphs remain 16 points and action glyphs 22 points. A shared internal artwork enum replaces the prior boolean choice and adds the status family while preserving action gates, checked state and shortcut tooltips. Existing default/Classic-menu button APIs retain their artwork.

gui.scope: Full UI suite passes. Existing Classic footer checks cover desktop/compact bounds, stable field positions, current-frame pointer coordinates, real selection dimensions, actual zoom changes and document/history isolation. Shared toolbar regression coverage includes both frontends, shortcut routing and single tooltips.

icons.scope: New six-symbol test renders both theme sources at four densities, checks equal alpha coverage and retained zoom accents, distinct colored/menu/theme texture identities and resident reuse. Existing cache limits and SVG checks pass. Default ID registry stays at 98; new status family has 12 SVGs. Generator reproduces assets byte for byte.

gpu.scope: Six raw light/dark desktop metrics, zoom-hover and compact 480x360 footer scenes. Desktop scenes use a real selection and pointer coordinates.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: Glyph proportions and action-family integration only. Percentage-field grouping, slider style and complete Windows/native footer fidelity remain open. Shared Classic zoom consumers inherit the status artwork; historical parity is not established. No zoom-engine or performance claim.
